text.tspan: I am a final-year Civil Engineering student at NITK Surathkal with a strong interest in
business analysis, data analytics, and product thinking.
Over the past year, I have worked across digital marketing, brand strategy, content, and
cross-functional operations including a startup internship where I contributed to investor
pitch decks, campaign analytics, and business operations directly under the founders.
I am currently building my analytics skill stack SQL, Python (pandas), Excel dashboards and
working on data projects focused on real business problems.
Open to Business Analyst, Product Analyst, and Data Analyst roles.
